decisions.reason: As a still-listed 2023 handle family in the firm’s core range, it has enough sunk development and range-building commitment that management is likely to continue it unless demand clearly weakens further.
Its own product page in 2024 signals visible commitment and strategic fit with the firm’s barrier-free and system-solution direction, making management inclined to persist with it.
Although only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, it remains part of the core door-hardware offering, so management is likely to keep it to justify the launch and preserve range breadth.
A dedicated page in both years plus publicly highlighted design awards create strong reputational and sunk-commitment reasons for management to keep this collection on the market.
